Our mission is to be your ultimate resource for visual art education using tutorials covering everything from fundamental techniques to advanced concepts in painting and drawing.

programme.title: Cordless Drill Stand
programme.desc: -Cordless drills are a staple in many woodworking shops and deserve a dedicated storage stand. George Vondriska shows you how to make your own cordless drill stand, fully equipped with a power strip for easy charging, plus storage drawers for tips and bits. This project is great for practicing biscuit joinery and hand tool work.

programme.title: Transparency and Big Stitch
programme.desc: For special effects, look through the design or use big stitches. Aviator and quilt maker Yvonne Fuchs uses transparency as a design element. Learn to work with a virtual quilt group to create a quilt for charity. Modern quilter Riane Menardi combines hand quilting with machine quilting to create high-contrast designs with depth, texture and movement.

programme.title: Grotto
programme.desc: Does your quilting room feel like the Croatian seaside? Yeah, ours neither. But follow Angela Walters through this illusion top, and you might just find yourself on a tropical vacay.

programme.title: Modern Technology Half-Square Triangle Quilt
programme.desc: Angela's reminded of her age as she relies on her kids to keep up with the digital world. Watch as she uses two basic shapes to create a mod half-square triangle quilt that's easier to make than it looks.

programme.title: Dress Up Your Garments
programme.desc: Garments get a makeover on today's show. You can make the same pattern over and over again but it will look totally different depending on your fabric and color choice and other surface embellishments. Angela Wolf begins with a beautiful and traditional sheath dress. An intricate applique trim completely changes this basic silhouette. Then, embroidery expert Eileen Roche demonstrates simple monogram techniques for all different garments -- it's a traditional look updated with a contemporary approach.

programme.title: Dress Up Your Wardrobe
programme.desc: We expand our view of classics by adding surface embellishments to personalize your garment. Cindy Hogan makes appliques from embroidery to add detail to any garment. Then, it's our next lesson in the Little Black Dress from Angela Wolf and different seam finishes including the Hong Kong. Last is embroidery expert Eileen Roche and easy dress embroidery for beautiful style.

programme.title: Leather and Chainmaille Jewelry
programme.desc: Author Laura Poplin combines the ancient art of leatherwork and chainmaille to make beautiful contemporary jewelry. Learn to make colorful dyed and painted leather rectangles and finish them into jewelry using classic leatherworking techniques. Laura shows how to connect leather pieces with Byzantine chainmaile weave to make a cuff style bracelet. Katie demonstrates a quick and easy cup chain bracelet.

programme.title: Brick Stitch Jewelry
programme.desc: Colorful brick stitch creations are simple and easy to expand as your skills improve. Francie Brodie shows how to use this popular stitch to make large, lightweight earrings for summer fun or holidays. Francie takes the mystery out of making the Slip and Slide bracelet using the right angle weave with single and multiple bead units. Katie shares more tips on organizing and storing your seed beads.

programme.title: Episode 6: DIY Embellishments
programme.desc: Renovate the surface of your pages. Julie Fei-Fan Balzer adds depth to her designs with amazing shrinking embellishments. May Flaum creates dynamic designs with misty effects using scraps. Ashley Horton has a tip for storing tiny letters and embellishments. Cheryl Boglioli makes 3-D designs with fringed fabric and felt.

programme.title: Episode 8: Artistic Endeavors
programme.desc: Part of the process of finding the artsy lifestyle is to appreciate art just for the process! You don't always need to make something useful! Julie Fei Fan Balzer begins with making a cover for her journal which houses her every day art and observations. Then, meet artist Betty Busby. Take a walk with her on a creative journey and pouring technique. This is a 2 part lesson that continues on the next episode. Next, Joe Rotella is back to create a card that has the perfect sentiment for many occasions. It incorporates the technology side of art.

Find out how to match thread colors to fabric so the quilting is nice and visible, while still blending in. Happy Quilting!

programme.desc: Learn how to professionally finish your sewing projects - seams and facings are one of the most important elements. First, Lindsey Johns shows how to select the right seam for the job. Then, Angela Wolf is on location with the Bella Top and neckline techniques including the v-neck and the proper facing technique.

programme.desc: People come in all shapes and sizes. The first project uses papier mache and garden gloves to create cowboy and girl puppets. Next, decorate your own flip flops. Draw faces in your art journal without even lifting your pencil off the page. And finally, create clothespin action figures of all kinds from ninjas -- to fairies.

programme.title: Make Believe
programme.desc: Anything can happen in the world of make-believe. Jenny Barnett-Rohrs turns into a scary monster with a fun headband. Katie Hacker makes a fantasy tent and then whips up a never-ending cherry pie. Jenny shows how to create a show with puppets you make yourself from blogger Mom Carolina Moore.

programme.title: City Living
programme.desc: Being in the city inspires a whole different vibe to your design. Kate Richbourg is inspired by commerce and the use of coins all over the world - using coins to make buttons and clasps. Then part 2 of fabrication with Julie Sanford. Turn all of those wires into a cuff. We finish up with Tammy Honaman and making chain using metal

programme.title: Style and Color
programme.desc: Molly Schaller shows how she uses trend boards to design jewelry and demonstrates trendy leather bracelets with large focal beads. Then she makes a colorful statement necklace and shares great tips on storing bead strands. In Katie's Beading Lesson she shows how to organize your work space. She offers suggestions for the right supplies and tools and adds another important element -- lighting, especially when working with small beads and distinguishing colors.

programme.title: Episode 7: Mixed Media Techniques
programme.desc: Don't' be afraid to get a little bit messy. This show is all about mixing it up with mixed media. Kathy Cano-Murillo creates a color page with acrylic paint and water. Next, Julie demonstrates mono printing. Then Dina Wakley uses filmstrips, dyed cheesecloth and spray ink to create a page layout. Last, Julie uses office supplies and household items to create texture on her scrapbook pages.

programme.title: Episode 6: Fantasy Living
programme.desc: The artful lifestyle includes creating a new look in the cosplay and gaming arena often centered on characters. Be a super hero or just dress like one. Today it's a steam punk persona with Joe Rotella and a fanciful top hat. Then it's time for a little magic with a gazing ball; perfect for a wizard but equally at home in your yard. Finally Joe is back to make a gauntlet out of a space age material.

programme.title: Surfer's Point
programme.desc: What do you do when your daughter picks out a quilt that's way harder than you're used to? Well if you're like Angela, you make an episode about it! This one's all about building up the confidence to take a bite out of something new. (You can do it too!)

programme.title: Weave it Be

Graphic artist and quilter Sheri Cifaldi-Morill appliquÃ©s traditional Hawaiian motifs with a modern twist.

programme.desc: The Walters household is eating healthy this week, but that doesn't mean Angela's quilts have to be. Today she is whipping up the Milky Way Quilt by Monique Dillard featuring Lily & Loom fabric.

programme.desc: Angela Walters reminisces about her days in the Girl Scouts while making the Campfire Quilt designed by the one and only Suzy Williams of Suzy Quilts.

programme.title: Fabric Feature
programme.desc: Learn about choosing the right fabric for your sewing project. One of the ways to make your sewing easier is to let your fabric do all the work. First, Joanne Banko has a free motion home dec project using the fabric pattern itself as a guide. Then, Angela Wolf is on location with the Bella Top. Mesh fabric adds a style element to the top and she finishes it off with a lesson on elastic casing.

programme.desc: The ladies are going big by thinking small! From compact cables to cute mini skeins, this one's all about the tiny treasures that keep those needles clicking.

programme.title: Texture
programme.desc: Today's show is all about texture -- texture is the feel or shape of a surface or thing. It's the smoothness or roughness, or maybe how soft or hard. We will learn about texture with a Paleolithic cave painting, a fun pony corral, and a friendly but prickly hedgehog. Learn how to add texture to your drawings with ordinary things from around the house in the Art Journal segment. Last, make a furry friend with giant chenille stems.

programme.title: Blending
programme.desc: One of the keys of impressionism is the blending together of images. The definition of this movement in art is characterized by visible brush strokes, ordinary subject matters, and an emphasis on light and its changing qualities. The first project is an impressionistic landscape using oil pastels and black mat board. Then we're using dye in spray bottles to make colorful geometric designs. Learn about color blending using special tools to create interesting effects in your art journal. And finally, blend colored glue to create a piece of art.

programme.title: Making Art Accessible
programme.desc: A key to making art accessible is to introduce it to our daily life. We begin with cast metal beads and pendants in our final bead inspiration. Then Jackie Truty introduces us to the technique of scraffito, using it to make plates to adorn our home. We end with Candie Cooper and a geometric bohemian necklace with a simple design easy enough for beginners.

programme.title: Water
programme.desc: Water is the inspiration for this episode. Learn a new technique with Eva Sherman, water casting. Then, Leslie Rogalski has a lesson on the chevron stitch featuring a tutorial on color stories.

programme.desc: A blank piece of paper challenges every maker. Illustrator Roxanne Coble balances humor and emotional themes in abstract mini-canvases. Lettering artist Janet Takahashi showcases calligraphy with decorative borders. Joe Rotella uses the today's design and cutting technology to create a mosaic box top. In the tip, Dina Wakley creates tags with paint and stamps.

programme.desc: We're having trouble seeing straight. Then again, it's probably the Drunkard's Path block! Angela's here to make sure the steps go "straight to your head."

programme.desc: This week the Midnight Quilter is busy assembling Easter baskets, and a quilt, of course. See Angela demonstrate how to do a mitered border, plus how to quilt using rulers!

We’ll explore the pattern, sizing and fabric on lesson one. Then meet Joanne Banko for another transitional garment and a quilted vest that features couching. It will take you from fall to spring and everything in between.

programme.title: What's a Super Hero without a Cape?
programme.desc: Not very super! They all need their signature cape! Joanne Banko has her version of a cape for the super hero woman. It features faux fur with a luxurious high pile for warmth and softness. Then Angela Wolf has the next step in our A line sew-along, with new variations as you become your own designer. She adds a center seam and lined pockets for a brand new look.

programme.title: It's All Relative
programme.desc: Shape and scale play an important role in all types of art but they are even more important in beads. We begin with our bead material guide and carved beads. Then Allie Buchman joins us for a tutorial on Czech bead shapes. Next Ashley Bunting creates basic wire frames to make earrings. We finish up with peyote basics from Tammy Honaman and the art of color and edging

programme.title: Exotic Travels
programme.desc: Sometimes we get our sense of place right at home and other times our motivation comes from far off places and a sense of the exotic; something different from our every day. In this episode designers moved beyond their comfort zone. Up first Tracy Gonzales creates hamsa earrings featuring sari silk. Then Nealay Patel is back with earrings inspired by the exotic peacock. Finally, Tammy Honaman has tips for hiding fibers with an exotic and international flare when using a loom.

programme.title: Episode 8: Travel
programme.desc: Set off in new directions. Julie Fei-Fan Balzer creates a travel journal with painted images. Cheryl Boglioli makes a handy caddy for creating on the road. Joe Rotella has a tip for keeping track of unmounted rubber stamps. Ashley Horton saves the most delicious travel memories on stenciled pages.

programme.title: Time to Stop
programme.desc: It's time to make it artsy. Knowing when to stop is as important as starting. There are subtle cues to help you decide when your project is complete. First, we begin with white space. Host Julie Fei Fan Balzer shows you don't have to fill in the whole page when you're stenciling. You can train your eye to leave just the right amount of space. Then it's a faux encaustic technique with Seth Apter. You'll learn when to stop and when to keep going. Finally, Mary Hettmansperger shares design techniques for fabric and fiber.

programme.title: Patterns
programme.desc: Patterns are a design, motif or decoration, formed from regular repeated elements. They can also be naturally-occurring or a random arrangement of shapes, colors which have a regular or decorative effect. Patterns can be stripes, or lines, or alternating colors. The first project has a striped pattern of knots tied with plastic lacing. Next, make felt cookies with a polka dot pattern. Then add a chevron pattern to your art journal. Last, create a folding play mat with landscape patterns of a city scene around a lake.

programme.title: Lines
programme.desc: A line is an infinitely extending one-dimensional figure; one that has length but not width or thickness. In art lines are the basis that give form to a piece of art. They can be straight or curved, thick or thin, and raised or flat. Projects featuring lines: a modern art canvas with paint and masking tape; lines become three dimensional as we make a playhouse for dolls or action figures; continue with your art journal and use brightly colored pens and a special tool to make spirograph line drawings. Finally make an unbreakable stained glass plaque with foil.

programme.title: Apollo 8 Christmas At The Moon
programme.desc: This one hour documentary profiles the first manned Mission to the Moon, and includes interviews with the astronauts and many of the NASA officials who were a part of this historic event.

programme.title: Origin of the Species
programme.desc: Abigail Child has been at the vanguard of experimental media since the 1980s. In her latest project, she offers viewers an eerie look into the present and future of AI, through the perspectives of scientists, entrepreneurs and a Black lesbian robot. Child’s thought-provoking film considers the emerging technology’s ethical and emotional implications, presenting a speculative, not-too-distant future grounded in sci-fi.

programme.title: The Neutral Ground
programme.desc: In 2015, CJ Hunt was filming the New Orleans City Council’s vote to remove four confederate monuments from the city. A forceful group of critics protested the decision and fearing retaliation, no crew would agree to remove the statues. CJ sets out to understand why a losing army from 1865 still holds so much power in America. At once funny and furious, this film documents the USA's troubled romance with the Lost Cause.

programme.title: Combat Forces
programme.desc: Today nuclear subs dominate the seas…yet their biggest threat is a diesel submarine. The modern diesel submarine is capable of a wide range of capabilities and it is known for its incredible stealth. We learn more about why they are so lethal in the dark depths of the Norwegian Fiords while on a NATO exercise inside a modern diesel submarine.

programme.title: Banzai Switzerland
programme.desc: Someone in Japan is in love with Switzerland, its culture, its folklore and, more specifically: the Swiss alphorn! The Tamagawa Alphorn Club from Nanasawa, Japan, is travelling to Switzerland to attend the International Alphorn Festival in Nendaz at the end of July. Alphorn playing started to be known in Japan in the 80ies and is becoming more and more popular in the last decade among retired people, but not only. Shigetoshi Nakagawa, founder of the group and a forest expert, is one of the first people who started to play the instrument; he has instructed to build and play the Alphorn in numerous regions, among children and elderly people. Thousands of Alphorn Clubs have been born lately and more and more Japanese are being interested in Swiss folklore culture and Switzerland in general.

programme.title: Crimes Of The Future
programme.desc: Through conversations with an array of Norwegian writers, filmmakers, psychiatrists, artists and more, Izquierdo investigates the impact of both the film and novel on generations of Norwegian culture and artistic practice, while exploring how it could speak about what it means to be an artist today.

programme.title: Origin of the Species
programme.desc: Abigail Child has been at the vanguard of experimental media since the 1980s. In her latest project, she offers viewers an eerie look into the present and future of AI, through the perspectives of scientists, entrepreneurs and a Black lesbian robot. Child’s thought-provoking film considers the emerging technology’s ethical and emotional implications, presenting a speculative, not-too-distant future grounded in sci-fi.

programme.title: Dreams From The Outback
programme.desc: The Kimberley in West Australia is home to various Aboriginal communities, where today most is in transition causing limbo and distress. Some has given up; others choose to fight both past and present demons to bring a change for the better to their people. In 'Dreams from the Outback' best friends Gabriel and Peter try to keep the ancient cultural traditions alive, with almost no support from the rest of their community. Felicity struggles to keep her family together after years of drinking and neglect and teeenagers Billy and Jordan are brothers who meet for the first time. The boys spend the days getting to know each other, exploring the outback and their culture.

programme.title: Combat Forces
programme.desc: Modern tanks are the equivalent of chariots on the battlefields of today. In Iraq and Afghanistan they are soldiers saviors or an enemy’s nightmare. We join tank crews from several nations as they train for deployment to overseas hotspots. This is the extreme edge of firepower!

programme.title: K2 and The Invisible Footmen
programme.desc: K2 is widely seen as the world's harshest mountain. Yet many indigenous porters make a living in its extreme conditions, carrying provisions for foreign climbing expeditions. Often risking their lives with only rudimentary equipment, they receive minimal pay for their efforts. Against a backdrop of breathtaking natural beauty, this cinematic doc explores the everyday courage and sacrifice of the men who call the 'Savage Mountain' their home.

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: The extraordinary international effort to find and rescue 12 boys and their coach from a remote cave in northern Thailand was watched closely by millions. Four Corners documents this wonderful and tragic tale from the day the boys first disappeared until the joyous moment the last person left the cave.

programme.title: Up In Smoke
programme.desc: Up In Smoke follows British scientist Mike Hands, who has laboured for 25 years to find a solution to replacing slash & burn agriculture in equatorial rainforests. This is a film about a struggle for our future. About the heroic, sometimes quixotic, mission of Mike Hands to get people to understand his revolutionary method.

programme.title: The Film Justifies The Means
programme.desc: Inside our dark editing rooms, we discover images filmed by a generation of filmmakers that reveal the reality of a country in conflict. Five decades later, we recover fragments of a cinematic memory that refuses to disappear.

programme.desc: Up In Smoke follows British scientist Mike Hands, who has laboured for 25 years to find a solution to replacing slash & burn agriculture in equatorial rainforests. This is a film about a struggle for our future. About the heroic, sometimes quixotic, mission of Mike Hands to get people to understand his revolutionary method.

programme.title: The Film Justifies The Means
programme.desc: Inside our dark editing rooms, we discover images filmed by a generation of filmmakers that reveal the reality of a country in conflict. Five decades later, we recover fragments of a cinematic memory that refuses to disappear.

programme.title: Combat Forces
programme.desc: Modern tanks are the equivalent of chariots on the battlefields of today. In Iraq and Afghanistan they are soldiers saviors or an enemy’s nightmare. We join tank crews from several nations as they train for deployment to overseas hotspots. This is the extreme edge of firepower!

programme.title: K2 and The Invisible Footmen
programme.desc: K2 is widely seen as the world's harshest mountain. Yet many indigenous porters make a living in its extreme conditions, carrying provisions for foreign climbing expeditions. Often risking their lives with only rudimentary equipment, they receive minimal pay for their efforts. Against a backdrop of breathtaking natural beauty, this cinematic doc explores the everyday courage and sacrifice of the men who call the 'Savage Mountain' their home.

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: The extraordinary international effort to find and rescue 12 boys and their coach from a remote cave in northern Thailand was watched closely by millions. Four Corners documents this wonderful and tragic tale from the day the boys first disappeared until the joyous moment the last person left the cave.

programme.title: Up In Smoke

programme.title: Combat Forces
programme.desc: Silent, covert, deadly; they are every battle commander’s secret weapon. Snipers are the long-range killers on the battlefield. We travel to several renowned sniper schools to see them train; learn about their advanced technology weapons and unique field craft.

programme.title: The Huddle
programme.desc: Though separated by a stretch of sea, Glasgow and Belfast share elements of political, sporting and religious culture rooted in the difficult, unresolved events faced by the Irish community during the twentieth century. The Huddle tells the stories of two Irish communities brought together by a devotion to the Celtic Football Club, and a shared faith in football. Exploring the contradictions between two cities facing radical ideological divides yet brought together by full stadiums, these are the interwoven and personal accounts of journalists, musicians, political militants, IRA fighters—all united by their love of football—on what it means to be Irish.

programme.title: Black And Arab
programme.desc: Nareeman Dosa - Saudi-born, and of Sudanese heritage, - grew up in the Arab world experiencing the casual racism that most Black Arabs face. In Black and Arab, she visits Tunisia, the first Arab country to have made racial discrimination a criminal offence, embarking on a journey to explore whether the law can alter deep-rooted prejudice, as well as speaking to other Black Arabs for whom racism has been a sadly pervasive part of their existence.

programme.title: Sheltered
programme.desc: In the busy world of the animal shelter, the loving bond between humans and animals is strained by the endless stream of abandoned cats, dogs, and rabbits. Pets are life companions - but for some, they are dispensable. With care and training by the passionate employees and dedicated volunteers, the hopeful animals are rehabilitated. Not every story has a happy ending, but the team fights on - even for the biggest misfits of them all.

programme.title: A Man & His Trumpet: The Leroy Jones Story
programme.desc: Follow the fascinating life story of trumpeter Leroy Jones. From the projects of New Orleans, Jones goes on to lead the brass band revival, and eventually catches the ear of Harry Connick Jr., and becomes known worldwide.

programme.title: Combat Forces
programme.desc: House-to-house combat is one of the most brutal and intense types of land warfare. Recent conflicts in Bosnia, Somalia and Iraq have reinforced the need for training in this specialized skill set. At urban warfare training facilities throughout the world, we learn first-hand what it takes to survive!

programme.title: Turning a Blind Eye
programme.desc: In October 2019 an unthinkable tragedy hit the peaceful village of Jura in Switzerland. Christophe Keller slit his wife Mélanie's throat before cutting his own. The crime shocked the whole country. What had happened between this couple, living a seemingly ordinary life with their three children? Each year, nearly 90,000 women are killed by their partner or ex-partner throughout the world. Could more have been done to save Mélanie?

programme.title: Alaska Long Hunters
programme.desc: A true life adventure set in 60's Alaska, Documenting a young pilots life who through it all, meets his creator God and finds life's true meaning. Based on the book "Last of the Long Hunters" by Mark Rose (2015) This story records the life of a young pilot flying in Alaska's Frontier Arctic. You'll experience the front seat thrills of bush planes and helicopters operating in the most dangerous conditions on Earth. Flying in minus 60 temperatures and horrific storms, airborne among the magnificent mountains, glaciers and rivers that only Alaska has to offer. Once you've read this volume you'll not be satisfied until you visit Alaska yourself. Includes true-life experiences of accidents, comradeship, humor, heartbreaks and life in Frontier Alaska, gone forever when dismantled into parks and native lands in the 1970's.

programme.title: The Time of Their Lives
programme.desc: The ultimate coming-of-age movie. With a combined age of almost 300, Hetty, Rose and Alison love to share their concerns on everything from terrorism and global warming to sex, death and the meaning of life. The Time of Their Lives reveals the everyday mystery of how very old people experience life and the intense challenges that old age brings. Like first-hand witnesses reporting back from the edge of their own mortality, Hetty, Rose and Alison tell us things which are never spoken of.

programme.title: An Italian Youth
programme.desc: Mathieu Volpe, film director invites us to follow Sokuro over a long period of time. Through a few key moments in the love story between Sokuro and Nassira, he offers another perspective on economic migration, which through this embodied representation takes on a more intimate quality. Regret, nostalgia and lack are the side effects of these reluctant exiles, done out of necessity rather than desire, that are too often kept in the shadows. By offering faces and bodies to a current topic, by embodying it and taking the time to explore its complexity, documentary cinema allows to deepen our reflection; Sokuro and Nassira’s contradictory yet profoundly human aspirations as well as their story is superimposed over the media narratives around the subject, enriching and humanising them.

programme.title: Combat Forces
programme.desc: Artillery is known as the King of Battle and for over 100 years it has played a pivotal role in combat. In this fascinating episode we learn how artillery works, what ammunition it fires and how it plays an important role in modern combat. We join gunners preparing for deployment to Iraq and Afghanistan who are on exercise.

programme.title: A Gentleman Thief
programme.desc: Vincenzo Pipino is a thief, he was convicted and has done over 25 years in prison both in Italy and in the rest of Europe and has expiated his faults. The documentary tells the story of this last gentleman thief.

programme.title: Undercover Jihadi
programme.desc: Each time a young man leaves a quiet suburb to join ISIS, we are shocked. Why do they do it? How can they be stopped? And if they come back, what to do about them? These are the questions that drive Mubin Shaikh on his quest to stop potential jihadis. Mubin went from militant extremist to undercover operative. Now a Counter-Terrorism expert, he takes to the frontlines of the battle against violent extremism around the world.

programme.title: Echoes Of The Empire: Beyond Genghis
programme.desc: Mongolia: for most of us, it brings to mind Genghis Khan's mighty empire. But in the present day, there is also a rich culture in the nation that grew from the ashes of Genghis Khan's triumphs, and a complex history aside from the bloodshed and conquest. A stunning cinematic view of the country's past and present, from the remarkable evolution of the Mongol Empire to intimate portraits of today’s Mongolians.

programme.title: Ambulance
programme.desc: When a talented young filmmaker tells the story of his country with compassion, beauty, and warmth in an honest, straight and raw first-person account of the war in Gaza in the summer of 2014. Mohamed Jabaly, a young man from the Gaza City, joins an ambulance crew as war approaches, looking for his place in a country under siege. While thousands of things are published on the recurring violence, the stories behind them remain hidden. Not this one. The ambulace team is led by captain Abu Marzouq who saved lives in many of Gaza's wars.

programme.title: Combat Forces
programme.desc: In the Vietnam War the USAF discovered that 90% of their casualties occurred during pilots first 10 missions. So a specialized training exercise was developed to provide pilots with the same combat missions they could expect in their first 10 missions. The results are incredible.

programme.title: Immersion
programme.desc: The darkness, the muffled noises, holding your breath until the very last minute: this documentary plunges into the world of free diving. Lakes, rivers, oceans - the abyss is a source of fascination for Igor. Travelling from Switzerland to the world’s deepest blue hole in the Caribbean, Igor starts to compete and is crowned Swiss champion of free diving, descending to 82 metres.

programme.title: Still Tibet
programme.desc: Embarking on a deep journey through one of the most remote ethnically Tibetan areas of China's Sichuan Province, filmmaker Miguel Cano hitchhikes, motorbikes and takes to foot to reach parts of the region that usually go untouched by tourists. With incredible cinematography, he journeys throughout the holy region to discover those fighting to preserve their spiritual and national identity, exposing a vulnerable civilization that retains an extraordinary mystical essence. "She was moved to tears as she told me of her last twenty years far from home.. it was then I made the promise to this woman to go deep into Tibet, and return to tell the world what I saw." Whilst travelling in Nepal, American filmmaker Miguel Cano chanced upon an elderly Tibetan lady. Weathered and frail, she told him of her past; how years ago she was driven from her home by Chinese authorities, forced to live out her days alone in exile. Moved by her suffering, Cano vowed to visit the often-uncharted region and explore an ancient culture increasingly under threat. Alone and with no clear itinerary, Cano immerses himself in the customs and traditions of the Tibetan people; his only objective being to absorb the unique culture of the region. "I needed to let the path take me where it will", he explains. Hitching rides on the back of motorbikes and sleeping in mountaintop monasteries, Cano is welcomed by a people of immense warmth and charm. "Even though we could not talk to each other, it felt as if we always said so much... communication felt more honest than I had ever experienced." Largely isolated from the rest of society, the autonomous region remains the cradle of eastern Buddhism and spirituality, many of its ancient traditions still intact. However, as ​Cano discovers, the region is not purely a religious utopia. Despite the warmth of the Tibetan locals, he is harassed at every turn by an an overbearing and very visible Chinese police force, and the underlying tensions between Tibetans and their Chinese neighbours is notable throughout the region. programme.title: Still Tibet
programme.desc: Embarking on a deep journey through one of the most remote ethnically Tibetan areas of China's Sichuan Province, filmmaker Miguel Cano hitchhikes, motorbikes and takes to foot to reach parts of the region that usually go untouched by tourists. With incredible cinematography, he journeys throughout the holy region to discover those fighting to preserve their spiritual and national identity, exposing a vulnerable civilization that retains an extraordinary mystical essence. "She was moved to tears as she told me of her last twenty years far from home.. it was then I made the promise to this woman to go deep into Tibet, and return to tell the world what I saw." Whilst travelling in Nepal, American filmmaker Miguel Cano chanced upon an elderly Tibetan lady. Weathered and frail, she told him of her past; how years ago she was driven from her home by Chinese authorities, forced to live out her days alone in exile. Moved by her suffering, Cano vowed to visit the often-uncharted region and explore an ancient culture increasingly under threat. Alone and with no clear itinerary, Cano immerses himself in the customs and traditions of the Tibetan people; his only objective being to absorb the unique culture of the region. "I needed to let the path take me where it will", he explains. Hitching rides on the back of motorbikes and sleeping in mountaintop monasteries, Cano is welcomed by a people of immense warmth and charm. "Even though we could not talk to each other, it felt as if we always said so much... communication felt more honest than I had ever experienced." Largely isolated from the rest of society, the autonomous region remains the cradle of eastern Buddhism and spirituality, many of its ancient traditions still intact. However, as ​Cano discovers, the region is not purely a religious utopia. Despite the warmth of the Tibetan locals, he is harassed at every turn by an an overbearing and very visible Chinese police force, and the underlying tensions between Tibetans and their Chinese neighbours is notable throughout the region. Tibet remains under threat from the West as well as the East, and the arrival of consumer culture has brought with it a sharp increase in debris and waste: amongst the breathtaking hills and valleys are growing mountains of drinks cans, food packaging and refuse. programme.title: Combat Forces
programme.desc: Hand-to-hand combat, it is every soldiers greatest fear. At the Army Combatives School in Fort Benning, Georgia, they teach soldiers how to fight to survive. Teach them skills that are beyond UFC…skills that kill!

programme.title: The Silent Scream
programme.desc: Since thirty years the data on the glaciers melting are truly alarming .There are men who have dedicated most of their lives to glaciers, photographing, measuring and monitoring them. This documentary collects their testimonies, bringing more awareness about the current state of glaciers and our mountains

programme.title: A Russian Fairytale
programme.desc: Following the break up of the Soviet union, a gang of children from broken homes made a new life together inside the derelict buildings of a once secret weapons manufacturing city. In their childhood innocence, they thought they were living a fairytale dream of freedom, but with starvation and sub zero temperatures crippling their health, reality soon hit home. Despite their efforts to care for one another, three members of their group died. For the survivors: they must try against hopeless odds to turn their lives around.

programme.title: Angel of Nanjing
programme.desc: The Yangtze River Bridge in Nanjing is the most popular place in the world to commit suicide, with over 5 attempts per week. For the past 11 years, blue-collar worker Chen Si has been patrolling this bridge every day, watching out for desperate people who've gone there to end their lives. With no formal training, he has saved over 300 people since he began; earning him the nickname the 'Angel of Nanjing'.

programme.title: The Good Death
programme.desc:
Janette is terminally ill and wants to die in a dignified way. Muscular dystrophy, the illness that Janette suffers from, has affected her family for generations. Janette's mother was wheelchair bound for decades, a prisoner in her own body. Janette refuses to wait for death in unbearable pain and opts for physician-assisted suicide. Before leaving on her last journey she has to explain her intention to her family members and close friends. Her son Simon has also inherited this illness and, therefore, has much more sympathy for her decision than his sister Bridget. If no cure for this illness is found, he will face the same decision process as his mother. Both children try to convince Janette to postpone her death. Do we own our life or does it own us?
The film uses feature film techniques, and engaging characters and their stories interwoven with Janette’s testament.

programme.title: Combat Forces
programme.desc: Today nuclear subs dominate the seas…yet their biggest threat is a diesel submarine. The modern diesel submarine is capable of a wide range of capabilities and it is known for its incredible stealth. We learn more about why they are so lethal in the dark depths of the Norwegian Fiords while on a NATO exercise inside a modern diesel submarine.

programme.title: Banzai Switzerland
programme.desc: Someone in Japan is in love with Switzerland, its culture, its folklore and, more specifically: the Swiss alphorn! The Tamagawa Alphorn Club from Nanasawa, Japan, is travelling to Switzerland to attend the International Alphorn Festival in Nendaz at the end of July. Alphorn playing started to be known in Japan in the 80ies and is becoming more and more popular in the last decade among retired people, but not only. Shigetoshi Nakagawa, founder of the group and a forest expert, is one of the first people who started to play the instrument; he has instructed to build and play the Alphorn in numerous regions, among children and elderly people. Thousands of Alphorn Clubs have been born lately and more and more Japanese are being interested in Swiss folklore culture and Switzerland in general.

programme.title: Crimes Of The Future
programme.desc: Through conversations with an array of Norwegian writers, filmmakers, psychiatrists, artists and more, Izquierdo investigates the impact of both the film and novel on generations of Norwegian culture and artistic practice, while exploring how it could speak about what it means to be an artist today.

programme.title: Origin of the Species
programme.desc: Abigail Child has been at the vanguard of experimental media since the 1980s. In her latest project, she offers viewers an eerie look into the present and future of AI, through the perspectives of scientists, entrepreneurs and a Black lesbian robot. Child’s thought-provoking film considers the emerging technology’s ethical and emotional implications, presenting a speculative, not-too-distant future grounded in sci-fi.

programme.title: Dreams From The Outback
programme.desc: The Kimberley in West Australia is home to various Aboriginal communities, where today most is in transition causing limbo and distress. Some has given up; others choose to fight both past and present demons to bring a change for the better to their people. In 'Dreams from the Outback' best friends Gabriel and Peter try to keep the ancient cultural traditions alive, with almost no support from the rest of their community. Felicity struggles to keep her family together after years of drinking and neglect and teeenagers Billy and Jordan are brothers who meet for the first time. The boys spend the days getting to know each other, exploring the outback and their culture.

programme.title: Combat Forces
programme.desc: Modern tanks are the equivalent of chariots on the battlefields of today. In Iraq and Afghanistan they are soldiers saviors or an enemy’s nightmare. We join tank crews from several nations as they train for deployment to overseas hotspots. This is the extreme edge of firepower!

programme.title: K2 and The Invisible Footmen
programme.desc: K2 is widely seen as the world's harshest mountain. Yet many indigenous porters make a living in its extreme conditions, carrying provisions for foreign climbing expeditions. Often risking their lives with only rudimentary equipment, they receive minimal pay for their efforts. Against a backdrop of breathtaking natural beauty, this cinematic doc explores the everyday courage and sacrifice of the men who call the 'Savage Mountain' their home.

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: The extraordinary international effort to find and rescue 12 boys and their coach from a remote cave in northern Thailand was watched closely by millions. Four Corners documents this wonderful and tragic tale from the day the boys first disappeared until the joyous moment the last person left the cave.

programme.title: Up In Smoke
programme.desc: Up In Smoke follows British scientist Mike Hands, who has laboured for 25 years to find a solution to replacing slash & burn agriculture in equatorial rainforests. This is a film about a struggle for our future. About the heroic, sometimes quixotic, mission of Mike Hands to get people to understand his revolutionary method.

programme.title: The Film Justifies The Means
programme.desc: Inside our dark editing rooms, we discover images filmed by a generation of filmmakers that reveal the reality of a country in conflict. Five decades later, we recover fragments of a cinematic memory that refuses to disappear.

programme.title: Combat Forces
programme.desc: Modern tanks are the equivalent of chariots on the battlefields of today. In Iraq and Afghanistan they are soldiers saviors or an enemy’s nightmare. We join tank crews from several nations as they train for deployment to overseas hotspots. This is the extreme edge of firepower!

programme.title: K2 and The Invisible Footmen
programme.desc: K2 is widely seen as the world's harshest mountain. Yet many indigenous porters make a living in its extreme conditions, carrying provisions for foreign climbing expeditions. Often risking their lives with only rudimentary equipment, they receive minimal pay for their efforts. Against a backdrop of breathtaking natural beauty, this cinematic doc explores the everyday courage and sacrifice of the men who call the 'Savage Mountain' their home.

programme.title: Combat Forces
programme.desc: Silent, covert, deadly; they are every battle commander’s secret weapon. Snipers are the long-range killers on the battlefield. We travel to several renowned sniper schools to see them train; learn about their advanced technology weapons and unique field craft.

programme.title: The Huddle
programme.desc: Though separated by a stretch of sea, Glasgow and Belfast share elements of political, sporting and religious culture rooted in the difficult, unresolved events faced by the Irish community during the twentieth century. The Huddle tells the stories of two Irish communities brought together by a devotion to the Celtic Football Club, and a shared faith in football. Exploring the contradictions between two cities facing radical ideological divides yet brought together by full stadiums, these are the interwoven and personal accounts of journalists, musicians, political militants, IRA fighters—all united by their love of football—on what it means to be Irish.

programme.title: Black And Arab
programme.desc: Nareeman Dosa - Saudi-born, and of Sudanese heritage, - grew up in the Arab world experiencing the casual racism that most Black Arabs face. In Black and Arab, she visits Tunisia, the first Arab country to have made racial discrimination a criminal offence, embarking on a journey to explore whether the law can alter deep-rooted prejudice, as well as speaking to other Black Arabs for whom racism has been a sadly pervasive part of their existence.

programme.title: Sheltered
programme.desc: In the busy world of the animal shelter, the loving bond between humans and animals is strained by the endless stream of abandoned cats, dogs, and rabbits. Pets are life companions - but for some, they are dispensable. With care and training by the passionate employees and dedicated volunteers, the hopeful animals are rehabilitated. Not every story has a happy ending, but the team fights on - even for the biggest misfits of them all.

programme.title: A Man & His Trumpet: The Leroy Jones Story
programme.desc: Follow the fascinating life story of trumpeter Leroy Jones. From the projects of New Orleans, Jones goes on to lead the brass band revival, and eventually catches the ear of Harry Connick Jr., and becomes known worldwide.

programme.title: Escape To Paradise
programme.desc: The Caribbean has always been a dream destination for holidaymakers dreaming of that perfect getaway, and Antigua has long been a favourite for the British. programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: It is one of China's most revered mountains. A religious center to this day for numerous sects of Chinese Buddhism, Emei Mountain was once the battle ground where Buddhism once clashed with one of China's leading religions at the time – Taoism. From the celestial revelations that led to the dawn of this religion on Emei mountain, through the legends of the White Snake, and to the religious ceremonies that brought an Emperor his heir, Emei mountain remains one of China's most illustrious religious hubs, where pilgrimages take place to this day. Discover China unveils the secrets behind Buddhism's rise to power, in the Tides between Taoism & Buddhism.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: The suicide of a woman shocked an entire village. It jolted an entire province, and word of her death even reached the imperial court. Upon hearing of the reasons behind this woman’s untimely death, the emperor decreed a magnificent arch be built in her memory, earning her family, her village and her province an honor of the highest degree. These beautiful arches, which dot China’s scenery, are the culmination of a culture founded on the remembrance of those who achieved a higher moral status than the rest of society, those who were chaste and remained pure, even in their deaths. Discover China passes on the story of Memorial Arches.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: At the turn of the century, a Child-Emperor ascended to the throne of the Chinese Qing Dynasty. Emperor Pu-Yi’s Reign was short lived and mired with treason, corruption and external influences. After abdicating his throne, Pu Yi knew his days in the imperial palace were numbered. Questions of his survival as a commoner began to trouble his mind. Upon looking at the wealth of priceless artifacts collected over 500 years of imperial reign, Pu Yi began plotting ways to smuggle these riches out. However, Pu Yi was not alone. Discover China brings you the story of how the precious treasures of the Imperial City disappeared from the capital palace, and where some reside today.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: At the turn of the century, a Child-Emperor ascended to the throne of the Chinese Qing Dynasty. Emperor Pu-Yi’s Reign was short lived and mired with treason, corruption and external influences. After abdicating his throne, Pu Yi knew his days in the imperial palace were numbered. Questions of his survival as a commoner began to trouble his mind. Upon looking at the wealth of priceless artifacts collected over 500 years of imperial reign, Pu Yi began plotting ways to smuggle these riches out. However, Pu Yi was not alone. Discover China brings you the story of how the precious treasures of the Imperial City disappeared from the capital palace, and where some reside today.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: At the foot of Tai Mountain sits an enigma – it is a temple, dedicated to the god of Tai Mountain, yet it bears a striking resemblance to an imperial palace. The secrets behind this grand and lavish temple lie in a ceremonial farce, carried out by a brazen and ambitious emperor, who would not heed his country's desperate situation and instead tried to bolster his status as sole ruler. As time passed, and this emperor's remains turned to ashes, all that remains from this fantastic episode in China's history is this stunning shrine. Discover China uncovers the secrets of this temple and the ceremonies which brought it to life, in The Emperor's Fantasy.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: A startling scientific discovery has changed the face of evolutionary science. A single tooth shook the scientific community. The secrets the skulls of ancient ape-men, found in a Beijing suburb potentially held the key to the missing link in Human evolution. Dozens of experts formed an international team in an attempt to uncover the tracks of this specimen, and find out more about its habits. On the eve of war, these skulls suddenly disappeared off the face of the earth, leaving no trace. As the history unfolds, scientists debated the origin of the Peking ape-man, as the world wonders where his remains might be.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: To escape war, the Qiang people settled down by the water at the foot of the Yulong Mountains. Join us, as Discover China visits Old Town Lijiang.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: It is one of China's most revered mountains. A religious center to this day for numerous sects of Chinese Buddhism, Emei Mountain was once the battle ground where Buddhism once clashed with one of China's leading religions at the time – Taoism. From the celestial revelations that led to the dawn of this religion on Emei mountain, through the legends of the White Snake, and to the religious ceremonies that brought an Emperor his heir, Emei mountain remains one of China's most illustrious religious hubs, where pilgrimages take place to this day. Discover China unveils the secrets behind Buddhism's rise to power, in the Tides between Taoism & Buddhism.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: The suicide of a woman shocked an entire village. It jolted an entire province, and word of her death even reached the imperial court. Upon hearing of the reasons behind this woman’s untimely death, the emperor decreed a magnificent arch be built in her memory, earning her family, her village and her province an honor of the highest degree. These beautiful arches, which dot China’s scenery, are the culmination of a culture founded on the remembrance of those who achieved a higher moral status than the rest of society, those who were chaste and remained pure, even in their deaths. Discover China passes on the story of Memorial Arches.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: At the turn of the century, a Child-Emperor ascended to the throne of the Chinese Qing Dynasty. Emperor Pu-Yi’s Reign was short lived and mired with treason, corruption and external influences. After abdicating his throne, Pu Yi knew his days in the imperial palace were numbered. Questions of his survival as a commoner began to trouble his mind. Upon looking at the wealth of priceless artifacts collected over 500 years of imperial reign, Pu Yi began plotting ways to smuggle these riches out. However, Pu Yi was not alone. Discover China brings you the story of how the precious treasures of the Imperial City disappeared from the capital palace, and where some reside today.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E01 - Diana A Portrait
programme.desc: 黛安娜，威爾士公主，真是令人著迷，並在她的時代留下了與其他女性不同的印記。作為童話公主、關心丈夫的妻子和時尚開創者，這部紀錄片探索了更深的意義，以揭示在持續的公眾關注背後的真實人。
programme.sub-title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E01 - Diana A Portrait

programme.sub-title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E01 - Diana A Portrait

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E42 - Diana A Model Princess
programme.desc: Diana's fashion sense was something people often looked at closely. She had a knack for picking outfits that were both stylish and sophisticated, which always grabbed attention. Her hats were another standout feature; she often wore elegant designs that added a touch of grace to her look. Her hair was also iconic, usually styled neatly with a slight bounce, perfectly framing her face and adding to her elegant appearance.
programme.sub-title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E42 - Diana A Model Princess

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E43 - Diana A Day In The Life
programme.desc: 當戴安娜訂婚時，她始終處於媒體的視野中。她在一生中專注於自己的兒子，並致力於慈善工作，例如對地雷發表意見。戴安娜利用自己的名氣來引起人們對這些和其他重要問題的關注。這部經過深思熟慮的節目更深入地研究了20世紀最驚人的人物之一。通過前所未見的畫面，它展示了她從一個害羞的少女走到成為威爾士公主戴安娜的歷程，包括她最後日子的感人時刻。
programme.sub-title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E43 - Diana A Day In The Life

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E27 - Diana And Sarah The Royal Wives Of Windsor Part 1
programme.desc: 作為皇室妻子，戴安娜與莎拉的生活充滿了孤獨和悲傷，儘管她們懷抱著對於為溫莎家帶來改變的殷切期望。原本該是她們“童話般”的生活，卻最終遠離了這一現實。

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E28 - Diana And Sarah The Royal Wives Of Windsor Part 2
programme.desc: 威爾士公主黛安娜和約克公爵夫人莎拉均嫁入女王的大家族，處於丑聞中心卻以不同方式離開。可惜的是，黛安娜已去世，而莎拉幸存下來，重新開始。隨著時間推移，她們的奮鬥可以得到更好的理解，本紀錄片探討了這些挑戰...

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E06 - Princess Diana's Legacy
programme.desc: 反思戴安娜公主的遺產，這個節目深入探討了她在突然去世後留下的遺產——她對孩子們、皇室以及愛她的人留下的印象。年輕的王子們在她的葬禮上因其舉止贏得了讚譽，但許多人質疑他們與查爾斯王子的關係未來將會如何發展。

programme.desc: 黛安娜，威爾士公主，真是令人著迷，並在她的時代留下了與其他女性不同的印記。作為童話公主、關心丈夫的妻子和時尚開創者，這部紀錄片探索了更深的意義，以揭示在持續的公眾關注背後的真實人。
programme.sub-title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E01 - Diana A Portrait

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E42 - Diana A Model Princess
programme.desc: Diana's fashion sense was something people often looked at closely. She had a knack for picking outfits that were both stylish and sophisticated, which always grabbed attention. Her hats were another standout feature; she often wore elegant designs that added a touch of grace to her look. Her hair was also iconic, usually styled neatly with a slight bounce, perfectly framing her face and adding to her elegant appearance.
programme.sub-title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E42 - Diana A Model Princess

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E43 - Diana A Day In The Life
programme.desc: 當戴安娜訂婚時，她始終處於媒體的視野中。她在一生中專注於自己的兒子，並致力於慈善工作，例如對地雷發表意見。戴安娜利用自己的名氣來引起人們對這些和其他重要問題的關注。這部經過深思熟慮的節目更深入地研究了20世紀最驚人的人物之一。通過前所未見的畫面，它展示了她從一個害羞的少女走到成為威爾士公主戴安娜的歷程，包括她最後日子的感人時刻。
programme.sub-title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E43 - Diana A Day In The Life

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E27 - Diana And Sarah The Royal Wives Of Windsor Part 1
programme.desc: 作為皇室妻子，戴安娜與莎拉的生活充滿了孤獨和悲傷，儘管她們懷抱著對於為溫莎家帶來改變的殷切期望。原本該是她們“童話般”的生活，卻最終遠離了這一現實。
programme.sub-title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E27 - Diana And Sarah The Royal Wives Of Windsor Part 1

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E28 - Diana And Sarah The Royal Wives Of Windsor Part 2
programme.desc: 威爾士公主黛安娜和約克公爵夫人莎拉均嫁入女王的大家族，處於丑聞中心卻以不同方式離開。可惜的是，黛安娜已去世，而莎拉幸存下來，重新開始。隨著時間推移，她們的奮鬥可以得到更好的理解，本紀錄片探討了這些挑戰...
programme.sub-title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E28 - Diana And Sarah The Royal Wives Of Windsor Part 2

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E06 - Princess Diana's Legacy
programme.desc: 反思戴安娜公主的遺產，這個節目深入探討了她在突然去世後留下的遺產——她對孩子們、皇室以及愛她的人留下的印象。年輕的王子們在她的葬禮上因其舉止贏得了讚譽，但許多人質疑他們與查爾斯王子的關係未來將會如何發展。
programme.sub-title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E06 - Princess Diana's Legacy

programme.desc: 真實故事將我們帶入一個簡單的皇室愛情故事。它提供了一個王子如何愛上一個普通中產階級女孩的幕後花絮。
programme.sub-title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E33 - Prince Edward and Sophie Rhys-Jones

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E30 - Prince William And Prince Harry Prisoners Of Celebrity
programme.desc: Two young men who have had to cope with extraordinarily challenging events and circumstances as, together, they have gone on to change the face of the British royal family and carve meaningful roles for themselves in the modern world. Made in 1999 two years after the death of their mother, Princess Diana, this original and touching documentary examines the lives of the royal princes, the legacy of their mother, the responsibilities of being a royal - and what the future holds for them.
programme.sub-title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E30 - Prince William And Prince Harry Prisoners Of Celebrity

programme.title: Wardens - S03:E06 - Operation Trespass
programme.desc: 蒙大拿的遊戲守衛正在注意違反狩獵法律的人，例如擅自闖入、過早狩獵、從汽車獵捕或捕獲尖角麋鹿。

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E01 - Empty Handed
programme.desc: En zonas remotas, la supervivencia es un juego cotidiano. Los anfitriones Chris y Casey Keefer se proponen sobrevivir 30 días en plena naturaleza. Cada nuevo día, estos hermanos enfrentarán sus habilidades como cazadores, leñadores y pescadores a un paisaje implacable y despiadado. DROPPED enfrenta a los espectadores a la dura realidad de que sólo se puede comer lo que se puede matar. Una auténtica prueba de supervivencia.

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E02 - Long Days, Cold Nights
programme.desc: Los hermanos Keefer despiertan en una tundra helada. Con más de 8 millas por recorrer y sin remos, los hermanos se ven obligados a abrirse camino a través de aguas poco profundas y tierra estéril mientras se dirigen río abajo en busca de su segundo escondite.
programme.sub-title: Dropped - S05:E02 - Long Days, Cold Nights

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S01:E03 - The Good, The Bad and Terry
programme.desc: 在這部經典的西部片中，克林特·伊斯特伍德 - 也被稱為「金髮」 - 三次拯救伊萊·華拉奇免於絞刑架，方法是射擊並切斷他懸掛的繩索。我們重現每個場景，並用所用武器測試這些射擊的現實性。
programme.sub-title: Hollywood Weapons - S01:E03 - The Good, The Bad and Terry

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S01:E04 - Dying Hard
programme.desc: 約翰·麥克林（布魯斯·威利斯）懸掛在一棟大樓的側面。拯救自己的唯一方法是通過玻璃窗射擊並突破安全區。使用同樣的貝雷塔92手槍，我們重建辦公室玻璃，看看我們的主人能否突破。

programme.title: The New Frontier - S01:E03 - The Inner Worlds
programme.desc: Orbitan entre nosotros y nuestra Estrella, los mundos interiores; ocultos bajo el resplandor del Sol, a menudo sólo visibles al amanecer o al atardecer. Venus, la primera y más brillante estrella del cielo vespertino, y Mercurio, que cruza fugazmente el disco solar. Son la mitad de los planetas terrestres de nuestro sistema solar y, sin embargo, al observar a nuestros compañeros, nos plantean más preguntas que respuestas.
programme.sub-title: The New Frontier - S01:E03 - The Inner Worlds

programme.title: Wardens - S03:E08 - Operation Rocky Mountain Front
programme.desc: 在狩獵季節，野生動物管理員透過用麋鹿誘餌抓捕盜獵者，追踪闖入者並檢查狩獵標籤，保持警覺。
programme.sub-title: Wardens - S03:E08 - Operation Rocky Mountain Front

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E05 - Fireside Fortune
programme.desc: Utilizando sus últimas energías, los hermanos Keefer se dirigen río abajo en busca de su siguiente alijo. La marea cambia cuando finalmente logran salir de la tundra abierta y entrar en el corazón del territorio de los alces.

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E06 - Now or Never
programme.desc: Con los ánimos levantados, los hermanos Keefer se disponen a avistar y acechar una manada de caribúes cercana, pero acercarse resulta más difícil de lo esperado.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S01:E07 - Scoreless
programme.desc: Utilizando un método único para abrir una caja fuerte, Nick Wells (Robert De Niro) utiliza un soplete para cortar a través de una caja fuerte, la llena de agua y hace estallar la puerta con un pequeño dispositivo explosivo. Probamos esto, junto con los efectos de un rifle antitanque de 20 mm en una caja fuerte de la película Thunderbolt and Lightfoot.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S01:E08 - Terry Vs Gorn
programme.desc: 特里和拉里在紐約上州的星際迷航原始系列拍攝場地進行測試。他們發現自己在USS Enterprise上，並測試柯克是否可以用竹管、鎂粉和石刀及皮革製造一門大炮。在星際迷航中它成功了，但這真的會有效嗎？
programme.sub-title: Hollywood Weapons - S01:E08 - Terry Vs Gorn

programme.title: The New Frontier - S01:E07 - The Moons of Olympus
programme.desc: These are the the Moon's of the gas giants. Each a unique and mysterious world of its own. Some have oceans of water, geysers of Sulphur or atmospheres of plastic. Some are just now being seen at the outer rim of our solar system, all are worthy of much more scrutiny.
programme.sub-title: The New Frontier - S01:E07 - The Moons of Olympus

programme.title: The New Frontier - S01:E08 - The Sun
programme.desc: Impulsa la maquinaria de la naturaleza; nuestro clima, fomenta y sostiene la vida en la tierra y en el mar. Cuando se pone por el Oeste, nos revela los miles de millones de estrellas hermanas que pueblan el cielo nocturno. Estudiamos nuestro Sol de cerca y, como una piedra Rosetta, puede revelarnos los secretos de todas las demás estrellas.
programme.sub-title: The New Frontier - S01:E08 - The Sun

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E04 - Elephant Country
programme.desc: Ivan joins the foremost anti-poaching team in Mozambique to bring down one particular group of poachers who have been killing local elephants for their ivory.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E27 - Diana And Sarah The Royal Wives Of Windsor Part 1
programme.desc: 作為皇室妻子，戴安娜與莎拉的生活充滿了孤獨和悲傷，儘管她們懷抱著對於為溫莎家帶來改變的殷切期望。原本該是她們“童話般”的生活，卻最終遠離了這一現實。
programme.sub-title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E27 - Diana And Sarah The Royal Wives Of Windsor Part 1

programme.title: The New Frontier - S01:E08 - The Sun

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E27 - Diana And Sarah The Royal Wives Of Windsor Part 1

programme.title: The New Frontier - S01:E09 - Exo Planets
programme.desc: A medida que los científicos y astrónomos observan las estrellas cercanas con mayor fidelidad, descubren planetas, exoplanetas, mundos fuera de nuestro sistema solar. Gracias a los avances tecnológicos y a la mejora de las técnicas, los científicos descubren cada día más mundos. Los científicos calculan que podría haber hasta 40.000 millones de planetas similares a la Tierra sólo en nuestra galaxia, la Vía Láctea.
programme.sub-title: The New Frontier - S01:E09 - Exo Planets

programme.title: The New Frontier - S01:E10 - Edge of the Universe
programme.desc: El cielo nocturno es una máquina del tiempo. Cuanto más miramos hacia el Universo, más atrás en el tiempo llegamos. Lo que vemos en el cielo nocturno es sólo un pequeño porcentaje del contenido del Universo, la mayor parte es materia oscura y energía oscura sabemos que existe; sin embargo, su naturaleza se nos escapa por el momento.
programme.sub-title: The New Frontier - S01:E10 - Edge of the Universe

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E05 - Capturing the Wild
programme.desc: Después de ver la desaparición de animales salvajes en el norte de África, Ivan se une a un equipo de captura de élite para ver cómo se captura, compra y vende la vida salvaje. programme.sub-title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E05 - Capturing the Wild

programme.title: Savage Wild - S03:E05 - Hammer Time
programme.desc: Manny recibe la visita de un enorme tiburón martillo.

programme.desc: Manny te muestra como caminar 10 millas fuera de los Everglades y sobrevivir en este hermoso y mortal lugar.

programme.title: Savage Wild - S03:E07 - Hunt for General Lee
programme.desc: Manny vuelve al Dead River de Florida en busca de un enorme caimán de 14 pies.
programme.sub-title: Savage Wild - S03:E07 - Hunt for General Lee

programme.title: Savage Wild - S03:E08 - Manny's Confession
programme.desc: Manny revive un feroz ataque de caimán.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild - S02:E01 - Man Eating Crocodiles of Zimbabwe
programme.desc: Mario takes a huge gamble by rafting along Africa's most dangerous river, the Zambezi, heading towards Lake Reba. But he ends up face-to-face with some of the largest and most fearsome man-eating crocodiles around.
programme.sub-title: Man Eats Wild - S02:E01 - Man Eating Crocodiles of Zimbabwe

programme.title: Man Eats Wild - S02:E02 - Namibian Desert Oryx
programme.desc: Mario heard from some locals about a strange-looking creature deep in the Namibian desert. So, he decided to brave the sweltering heat in a hot air balloon to track down the oryx.
programme.sub-title: Man Eats Wild - S02:E02 - Namibian Desert Oryx

programme.title: Man Eats Wild - S02:E03 - Kalahari Bushmen
programme.desc: In the Kalahari desert, there’s an old tribe living off the land. Mario spends a week working hard to gather food to share with them.
programme.sub-title: Man Eats Wild - S02:E03 - Kalahari Bushmen

programme.title: Man Eats Wild - S02:E04 - Untouched Atolls
programme.desc: Just off the coast of Africa is a strip of 115 islands called the Seychelles. Mario educates his audience as to how to fish for reef species. Out of know where he even attempts to swim with a sailfish.
programme.sub-title: Man Eats Wild - S02:E04 - Untouched Atolls

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S06:E05 - Montana Elk Part 1
programme.desc: En busca de alces, Laramy ha hecho el largo viaje a caballo en lo profundo de estas montañas de Montana. Ahora sólo tiene que ponerse a tiro de uno de estos enormes toros.
programme.sub-title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S06:E05 - Montana Elk Part 1

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S06:E06 - Alaska Trapping
programme.desc: Laramy pone a prueba sus habilidades con las trampas en los parajes salvajes de Alaska. Puede ser diferente, pero no menos gratificante.
programme.sub-title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S06:E06 - Alaska Trapping

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S06:E07 - Montana Elk Part 2
programme.desc: Laramy caza alces en Montana y acecha a un enorme toro. Con sólo su arco y flecha, Laramy dispara y demuestra su valía. Pero hacer el disparo es sólo la mitad de la batalla.
programme.sub-title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S06:E07 - Montana Elk Part 2

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E12 - The New Royals
programme.desc: Princesses Beatrice and Eugenie have gone through a lot of media attention and tough situations in their lives. From their parents' very public split to being targeted by the press, they've been through quite a bit. Despite all this, they remain dedicated to supporting the monarchy with their charity work. Through serving the Commonwealth, both sisters continue to make a positive impact.
programme.sub-title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E12 - The New Royals

programme.title: Wardens - S03:E10 - Operation Crow Creek
programme.desc: 蒙大拿州的遊戲管理員正在偏遠地區尋找偷獵者，而其他管理員則處理更多非法狩獵和釣魚活動，並試圖阻止一名老人餵鹿。

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E09 - Head to Head
programme.desc: Con la tormenta ártica pisándoles los talones, los hermanos Keefer corren río abajo para llegar a su siguiente depósito de suministros, pero se pierden cuando el río se divide en un laberinto de pequeños canales.

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E10 - Edge of the Storm
programme.desc: Cuando las temperaturas caen en picado, los hermanos Keefer se abren paso río abajo a través de aguas heladas y fuertes vientos en contra con la esperanza de llegar al lugar de extracción antes de que la tormenta ártica lo reclame.
programme.sub-title: Dropped - S05:E10 - Edge of the Storm

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S02:E03 - Just-Terry-Fied
programme.desc: 特里和拉里對節目驗證進行了測試。

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S02:E04 - Terry's Reindeer Game
programme.desc: 特里和拉里測試馴鹿遊戲中班·阿弗萊克和查理茲·塞隆被困在冰凍湖底的場景，並通過水下用12口徑霰彈槍開三槍以打破冰面逃脫。
programme.sub-title: Hollywood Weapons - S02:E04 - Terry's Reindeer Game

programme.title: The New Frontier - S02:E01 - Astronauts
programme.desc: Cien kilómetros por encima de la superficie terrestre se encuentra una frontera invisible: el borde del espacio. Se trata de la Línea de Karman, el límite entre la atmósfera de nuestro planeta y lo que hay más allá. ¿Qué hace falta para cruzar esa línea?

programme.title: The New Frontier - S02:E02 - Getting UpThere
programme.desc: Lanzar cargas útiles al espacio es una tarea muy difícil, históricamente los lanzamientos de cohetes son las proverbiales 'espadas en arados' Misiles diseñados para transportar cabezas atómicas ahora envían satélites y sondas al sistema solar. Irónicamente, es una de las pocas hazañas de la Humanidad que no se dan en la naturaleza.
programme.sub-title: The New Frontier - S02:E02 - Getting UpThere

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E06 - On the Frontline
programme.desc: Desde salvadores de rinocerontes e investigadores de leones, hasta empresarios astutos y equipos de seguridad armados, Iván recorre la primera línea de la conservación para conocer a las personas que están remodelando y protegiendo el África salvaje. ¿Qué significa realmente dedicar la vida a la causa de la conservación? Ivan viaja a cuatro países distintos para averiguar qué mueve a estos héroes anónimos.
programme.sub-title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E06 - On the Frontline

programme.desc: 皇太后，活得和世紀本身一樣長，是英國生活中備受喜愛的人物。她是二次世界大戰期間的勇氣象徵，是一種超越時間的穩定偶像，贏得了人們深厚的愛慕，這只是被女王自己所匹敵。

programme.desc: La Estación Espacial Internacional es sin duda la joya de la corona de la órbita terrestre baja: puesto de observación, laboratorio de investigación y aula. programme.title: The New Frontier - S02:E04 - Shore to Shore
programme.desc: Nuestra naturaleza marinera se ha trasladado bien a la era espacial, tratando de navegar hacia lo desconocido en busca de riquezas de uno u otro tipo. Mientras Europa y Asia mantienen su interés por la Luna, rica en recursos, Estados Unidos y la NASA han puesto sus miras nada menos que en misiones tripuladas a Marte. ¿Serán capaces de ir de costa a costa en el más peligroso de los mares desconocidos, el espacio profundo?
programme.sub-title: The New Frontier - S02:E04 - Shore to Shore

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E07 - Sold into Slavery
programme.desc: Ivan está investigando el comercio ilegal de carne de caza en Kinshasa, cuando se topa con tres crías de chimpancé cautivas que se venden en el mercado negro. Se planea un dramático rescate en el que los chimpancés son entregados sanos y salvos a un lugar dedicado a proporcionar un futuro mejor a todos los primates de África.

programme.title: Dropped - S06:E04 - Driving the Bus
programme.desc: Chris y Casey se inician en los sabores de la naturaleza neozelandesa y sufren un duro despertar. Los juegos mentales de la Madre Naturaleza empiezan a afectar a la fuerza mental de los hermanos, mientras su balsa hinchable sigue siendo un grave problema.

programme.title: Dropped - S06:E05 - Round Two
programme.desc: Tensions run high as Chris and Casey disagree on what their next course of action should be. Without clear cache directions, the brothers are left with a hard choice. Should they stay, or should they go?

programme.title: Dropped - S06:E06 - Peaks and Valleys
programme.desc: Chris y Casey caminan por la ladera de la montaña, pero las empinadas laderas y el esquisto movedizo hacen que la caminata no sea nada fácil. Los hermanos se enfrentan al agotamiento y la falta de energía, y sienten la presión de encontrar pronto nuevas fuentes de alimento o pasar hambre.

programme.title: Dropped - S06:E07 - Day in the Life
programme.desc: La balsa sigue causando problemas mientras Chris y Casey gastan valiosas energías intentando mantenerse a flote. Con sus días en el Pacífico Sur menguando, los hermanos han llegado a su punto de ruptura'hasta que un nuevo descubrimiento deja un impacto duradero.
programme.sub-title: Dropped - S06:E07 - Day in the Life

programme.title: Dropped - S06:E08 - Bridge the Gap
programme.desc: Chris y Casey han atravesado Nueva Zelanda a pie durante semanas. Luchar por sus vidas ha hecho mella en sus emociones y habilidades. Se asocian para cazar jabalíes, pero los alijos utilizados para sobrevivir crean nuevos retos y profundas frustraciones.

programme.title: The Trail- S01:E03 - Relocation
programme.desc: Laramy se da cuenta de que la caza escasea debido a los lobos y decide poner distancia entre él y la manada. Es hora de levantar el campamento y trasladarse a un nuevo lugar.

programme.title: The Trail - S01:E04 - White Death
programme.desc: La nieve, lo que los montañeses llamaban la muerte blanca, detiene a Laramy en su camino. Además, su fiel caballo 7 ha sufrido una herida en una pata. Laramy debe cuidar de Siete, luchar contra el hambre y sobrevivir a la nevada.

programme.title: The Trail - S01:E05 - The Struggle
programme.desc: Laramy sigue atrapado en el Campamento Hell Hole, cuidando de la pierna de 7, y luchando por sobrevivir a las gélidas temperaturas sin comida.

programme.title: The Trail - S01:E06 - On the Move
programme.desc: Laramy y Siete abandonan el campamento Hell Hole y emprenden de nuevo el camino. Se dirigen a una elevación más baja en busca de un lugar más permanente al que llamar hogar.
programme.sub-title: The Trail - S01:E06 - On the Move

programme.title: The Trail - S01:E07 - Permanent Residence
programme.desc: Laramy y Siete encuentran un lugar para acampar a largo plazo fuera de la nieve y a menor altitud. Laramy se pone manos a la obra para construir un refugio permanente y buscar comida.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S01:E10 - Season Recap
programme.desc: Echamos un vistazo a las historias de supervivencia de la temporada con una mirada más profunda del ex soldado de las Fuerzas Especiales del Ejército, Terry Schappert.
programme.sub-title: Fight to Survive - S01:E10 - Season Recap

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E01 - After the Fall
programme.desc: El escalador Craig DeMartino se precipita 30 metros por un acantilado de granito. Convertido en un montón de huesos rotos, Craig se aferra a la vida. En una fracción de segundo, la vida de Craig se convierte en una inspiradora lucha por sobrevivir.
programme.sub-title: Fight to Survive - S02:E01 - After the Fall

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E02 - A River's Grasp
programme.desc: En un aislado río de montaña, el pescador Dean Ririe queda irremediablemente atrapado bajo una roca con el agua hasta el cuello. En aguas heladas que deberían matar a un hombre, Dean lucha por su vida a kilómetros de la ayuda.
programme.sub-title: Fight to Survive - S02:E02 - A River's Grasp

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E03 - ATV Nightmare

programme.desc: Tensions run high as Chris and Casey disagree on what their next course of action should be. Without clear cache directions, the brothers are left with a hard choice. Should they stay, or should they go?

Los hermanos se enfrentan al agotamiento y la falta de energía, y sienten la presión de encontrar pronto nuevas fuentes de alimento o pasar hambre.

programme.title: Dropped - S06:E07 - Day in the Life

programme.sub-title: Dropped - S06:E07 - Day in the Life

programme.title: The Trail- S01:E03 - Relocation
programme.desc: Laramy se da cuenta de que la caza escasea debido a los lobos y decide poner distancia entre él y la manada. Es hora de levantar el campamento y trasladarse a un nuevo lugar.
